property_summary: For any caller and any withdraw amount where the contract has sufficient balance, the reference contract always reduces its own balance by the withdrawn amount after withdraw(...) returns; the mutant that uses send can fail to transfer (silently returning false) and thus leave the contract balance unchanged for some inputs (fuzz-found recipient behaviour/amount).
change_summary: Replace transfer to send (returns bool instead of reverting) so withdraw may silently fail and change observed post-withdraw balance.
